data.narrative:
Perigee Aerospace, founded by Shin Dong-Yoon, is a Series D-stage company in Space & Aerospace that has raised $56.64M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including Apex Space, Varda Space Industries, and SpaceX.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement to the $57M capital raised proxy, yielding $85M. Peer-median analysis uses 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B), Apex Space ($2.3B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), and Skyryse ($1.1B)—with a median valuation of $1.9B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable because Perigee's revenue is not disclosed; the sector P/S median of 27.4x across public Space & Aerospace companies cannot be meaningfully applied without this input.

The triangulated valuation range is $72M (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.0B across the two applicable methods. The wide range reflects material uncertainty in stage-progression versus peer comparability; the stage-progression method assumes linear fundraising calibration, while peer multiples vary significantly (range: $1.1B–$8.0B), partly driven by differential product maturity and revenue traction. Resolution of revenue scale and near-term commercialization trajectory would materially tighten this band.
